text: On macOS, a Claude Code session you host gets a browser of its own, to check the web app it is building.
When Claude uses it, everyone in the session sees its steps in the timeline: the page it opened, what it read and what it clicked.
With Every step, each browser call is a step of its own, under its tool name.
Its screenshots show on the step, with the page's address. Select one to open it full size in a tab.
It is not your browser. It starts empty, never shows on screen, and the pages it opens can't reach SpecDeck. The terminal shows what Claude types, so use test accounts.
To turn it off, clear Give Claude a browser in Settings. Show screenshots in the timeline keeps the pictures out.
For now, only Claude Code sessions on macOS get it.
